component.name: Almide Playground
component.summary: Write, run and share Almide programs

description.p: Almide Playground is a complete environment for the Almide programming language. Write a program, press Run, and see what it prints — or what it draws.

ul.li: The Almide compiler itself compiles your code, and it runs in a sandbox on your computer
Programs that print SVG, PPM or simple HTML show up in the Visual tab
Build GUI apps with the ceangal framework and use them inside the playground
Syntax highlighting, errors as you type, multiple files, light and dark themes
Examples from Hello World to parsers and graphics
Share a whole project in one link, or export it as a buildable project
Optional AI assistant with your own API key (Claude, GPT or Gemini)
